check.title: Status
check.help: Checks without network access whether the service is entered and the token is found.

token.help: API token of the service. Tapesmith stores it in Windows Credential Manager, never in a file.

hosts.empty: No Proxmox host yet. Add a host with its address and save its token afterwards.
hosts.tokenHelp: API token of this host with read access.

paperlessUrl.label: Address
paperlessUrl.help: Address of Paperless-ngx, e.g. http://192.0.2.12:8010 (without / at the end)

paperlessPublicUrl.label: Address for QR codes
paperlessPublicUrl.help: Only needed if Paperless is reachable from outside under a different address

paperlessAsnRange.label: Number range
paperlessAsnRange.help: Tapesmith assigns the ASN numbers from this number range

paperlessAsnPrefix.label: Prefix
paperlessAsnPrefix.help: Comes before the number; capital letters, digits and hyphen

paperlessAsnWidth.label: Digits
paperlessAsnWidth.help: Number of digits, padded with zeros (5 gives ASN00042)

paperlessWarrantyFields.label: Warranty fields
paperlessWarrantyFields.help: Names of the custom fields in Paperless the warranty label reads from

paperlessTimeoutS.label: Timeout
paperlessTimeoutS.help: How long Tapesmith waits for an answer from Paperless

proxmoxHosts.label: Proxmox hosts
proxmoxHosts.help: Per host a name and address; set the API token (with read access) below after saving

proxmoxTimeoutS.label: Timeout
proxmoxTimeoutS.help: How long Tapesmith waits for an answer from Proxmox

obsidianMcpUrl.label: MCP address
obsidianMcpUrl.help: Address of the Obsidian MCP server, e.g. http://192.0.2.12:8092/mcp

obsidianVaultDir.label: Vault folder
obsidianVaultDir.help: Instead of the MCP server: the vault folder on this PC

obsidianFolders.label: Folders with notes
obsidianFolders.help: Only notes from these folders, separated by commas

obsidianAttachmentsDir.label: Attachments folder
obsidianAttachmentsDir.help: Subfolder in the vault for images of printed labels

obsidianAppendAfterPrint.label: Record the print in the note
obsidianAppendAfterPrint.help: Writes a line with the date into the note after printing

obsidianTimeoutS.label: Timeout
obsidianTimeoutS.help: How long Tapesmith waits for an answer from the MCP server

homeassistantUrl.label: Address
homeassistantUrl.help: Address of Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.0.2.9:8123

homeassistantTodoEntity.label: To-do list
homeassistantTodoEntity.help: List for maintenance tasks in the form todo.<name>; empty = none

homeassistantBatteryBelow.label: Battery below
homeassistantBatteryBelow.help: Shows devices below this battery level; 101 = all devices

homeassistantTimeoutS.label: Timeout
homeassistantTimeoutS.help: How long Tapesmith waits for an answer from Home Assistant

assetsRange.label: Number range
assetsRange.help: Tapesmith assigns the asset numbers from this number range

assetsPrefix.label: Prefix
assetsPrefix.help: Comes before the number, e.g. HL-

assetsWidth.label: Digits
assetsWidth.help: Number of digits, padded with zeros (4 gives HL-0042)

assetsCheckDigit.label: Append check digit
assetsCheckDigit.help: An extra digit makes typos visible when copying the number

shortlinkBaseUrl.label: Short link address
shortlinkBaseUrl.help: Address of the short link service, e.g. https://l.example.com; empty = QR code with the long address

shortlinkAdminUrl.label: Admin address
shortlinkAdminUrl.help: Only needed if new short links are created through a different address

shortlinkTimeoutS.label: Timeout
shortlinkTimeoutS.help: How long Tapesmith waits for an answer from the short link service

kleinanzeigenRange.label: Number range
kleinanzeigenRange.help: Tapesmith assigns the item numbers from this number range

kleinanzeigenPrefix.label: Prefix
kleinanzeigenPrefix.help: Comes before the number, e.g. KA-

kleinanzeigenWidth.label: Digits
kleinanzeigenWidth.help: Number of digits, padded with zeros (3 gives KA-007)

kabelRange.label: Number range
kabelRange.help: Tapesmith assigns free cable numbers from this number range

kabelPrefix.label: Prefix
kabelPrefix.help: Comes before the number, e.g. K-

kabelWidth.label: Digits
kabelWidth.help: Number of digits, padded with zeros (3 gives K-012)

kabelTiaPattern.label: TIA-606 pattern
kabelTiaPattern.help: Structure of the cable ID from rack, rack unit and port

plausiNetworks.label: Own networks
plausiNetworks.help: The check before printing marks IP addresses outside these networks; separated by commas

plausiDnsCheck.label: Check hostnames in DNS
plausiDnsCheck.help: Warns if a hostname on the label cannot be resolved

plausi.title: Plausibility check
plausi.description: Checks IP addresses and hostnames on labels before printing.
